Computer Fundamentals.practice: Learn basic computer hardware, operating systems, files, applications and internet concepts.
Computer Fundamentals.project: Create a document explaining the components of a computer system.

Programming Fundamentals.practice: Solve basic problems involving variables, conditions, loops, functions and data structures.
Programming Fundamentals.project: Build a simple calculator or student grade calculator.

Mathematics.practice: Practice algebra, functions, matrices and basic mathematical reasoning.
Mathematics.project: Implement basic mathematical operations and visualizations in Python.

Statistics.practice: Practice mean, median, variance, probability, distributions and hypothesis testing.
Statistics.project: Analyze a small dataset and calculate descriptive statistics.

Python.practice: Solve Python programming problems involving functions, lists, dictionaries, strings and files.
Python.project: Build a command-line student management system.

SQL.practice: Practice SELECT, WHERE, JOIN, GROUP BY, aggregate functions and subqueries.
SQL.project: Create a student database and write queries to analyze student records.

NumPy.practice: Practice arrays, indexing, slicing, broadcasting and mathematical operations.
NumPy.project: Analyze numerical data using NumPy arrays.

Pandas.practice: Practice loading, cleaning, filtering, grouping and analyzing datasets.
Pandas.project: Analyze a CSV dataset and produce a summary report.

Machine Learning.practice: Practice regression, classification, feature preprocessing and model evaluation.
Machine Learning.project: Build a house-price prediction or student-performance prediction model.

Scikit-learn.practice: Train and evaluate classification and regression models.
Scikit-learn.project: Build an end-to-end machine learning pipeline.

Deep Learning.practice: Practice neural networks, backpropagation, optimization and model evaluation.
Deep Learning.project: Build an image or text classification model.

TensorFlow.practice: Complete beginner Keras tutorials and train neural networks.
TensorFlow.project: Build an image classification model using TensorFlow.

PyTorch.practice: Practice tensors, datasets, data loaders, neural networks and optimization.

R.practice: Practice vectors, data frames, functions and statistical analysis.
R.project: Perform statistical analysis on a dataset using R.

Java.practice: Practice object-oriented programming, collections and exception handling.
Java.project: Build a console-based library management system.

C++.practice: Practice STL, functions, classes, pointers and data structures.
C++.project: Build a command-line inventory management system.

JavaScript.practice: Practice functions, objects, arrays, DOM manipulation and asynchronous programming.

HTML.practice: Create webpages using semantic HTML, forms, tables, links and multimedia.

CSS.practice: Practice selectors, box model, flexbox, grid and responsive design.

React.practice: Practice components, props, state, events and hooks.

Node.js.practice: Build HTTP servers, APIs and backend applications.
Node.js.project: Build a REST API for a student profile system.

REST API.practice: Practice HTTP methods, status codes, requests, responses and JSON.
REST API.project: Build a REST API for career recommendations.

Git.practice: Practice commits, branches, merges, pull requests and resolving conflicts.
Git.project: Collaborate on a small project using Git branches.

GitHub.practice: Practice repositories, branches, pull requests and issues.
GitHub.project: Create and collaborate on a team GitHub repository.

Linux.practice: Practice the terminal, files, permissions, processes and networking commands.
Linux.project: Create a Bash script that automates file management.

Docker.practice: Build images, run containers and create Dockerfiles.

Kubernetes.practice: Practice pods, deployments, services and configuration.
Kubernetes.project: Deploy a containerized web application on Kubernetes.

AWS.practice: Learn cloud concepts and practice basic AWS services such as S3 and Lambda.
AWS.project: Deploy a simple web application using AWS.

Azure.practice: Learn cloud concepts, Azure compute, storage and networking.
Azure.project: Deploy a simple application using Azure.

Tableau.practice: Create charts, dashboards and interactive visualizations.

Power BI.practice: Import data, clean data and create interactive dashboards.
Power BI.project: Build a career or student analytics dashboard.

Excel.practice: Practice formulas, functions, filtering, pivot tables and charts.

Selenium.practice: Automate browser actions and test web applications.

Postman.practice: Send API requests and test REST endpoints.

Cybersecurity Fundamentals.practice: Learn authentication, authorization, vulnerabilities, threats and security controls.
Cybersecurity Fundamentals.project: Perform a basic security assessment of a demo application.

Networking.practice: Learn IP addresses, DNS, HTTP, TCP/IP, routing and basic network troubleshooting.

Cloud Computing Fundamentals.practice: Learn compute, storage, networking, virtualization and cloud deployment concepts.
Cloud Computing Fundamentals.project: Deploy a simple application to a cloud platform.

Database Fundamentals.practice: Learn tables, keys, relationships, normalization and basic SQL.

Web Fundamentals.practice: Learn how HTML, CSS, JavaScript and HTTP work together.
Web Fundamentals.project: Build and publish a basic responsive website.

Testing Fundamentals.practice: Learn test cases, test plans, functional testing and defect reporting.
Testing Fundamentals.project: Create a test plan and test cases for a web application.

Verilog.practice: Practice modules, ports, combinational logic, sequential logic and testbenches.

Visual Design.practice: Practice typography, color theory, contrast, spacing, alignment and visual hierarchy.

Web3.practice: Learn blockchain basics, smart contracts, wallets and decentralized applications.

Windows Server.practice: Learn server administration, users and permissions, DNS, networking and monitoring.
